philosophyParagraphs: I'm a brand identity designer based in Chennai, focused on helping D2C and hospitality businesses build sharp, memorable visual identities. My work is built around consumer perception — how people see, trust, remember, and choose a brand.
I got here without a classroom or a shortcut — just curiosity, obsessive attention to detail, and real client work across FMCG, sports, fashion, and food & hospitality brands over the past two years.
I am especially interested in FMCG, sports, fashion, lifestyle, food, wellness, and consumer product brands that sell directly to people.

My approach is simple: I don't have a one-size-fits-all style, because your brand shouldn't look like everyone else's. Every project starts with understanding your business, your audience, and what you're really trying to say, so we can build a visual identity that says it better than words ever could.
